messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Service error rate spike detected for /v1/generate. 5xx rate > 6% over 3m. Threshold breached by 2x. Auto-created war room: https://warroom.redwood/rooms/WR-1735689600 (private). Paging primary oncall now.
serena.wong: Acknowledged. I'm joining war room. Assigning owner... @john-oncall can you take incident owner? If not, I'll triage.
john-oncall: I am oncall and taking owner. Confirmed. Paging logs show spike at 15:34 UTC. :eyes: 
dave_kapoor: Oncall, please confirm whether customer-facing latency? Any 429/503 spikes too?
john-oncall: 503s and 5xx. No big latency increase for successful requests. Looks like model shard failures. Extracting logs now.
maya: I'll start a status page draft. Tentative impact: partial degraded responses for text-generation API in us-west-2, some requests failing with 5xx. No data exfiltration. Draft below — please edit.
maya: ```Status: Degraded Service
Components: Text Generation API (/v1/generate)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors for some requests, estimated ~6-10% of traffic in us-west-2.
Start time: 2024-11-30T15:34:00Z
Update: We're investigating, oncall team engaged.
``` 
dave_kapoor: +1 on that wording. Add "no customer data exposure suspected" line.
ryan-product: Suggest we notify enterprise customers with Dedicated capacity in us-west-2. I can ping AMs. Who wants to prep an email?
serena.wong: @ryan-product please coordinate AM notice. @elaine (infra) can you try scaling the dedicated pool and toggling fallback to smaller quantized model variant? Runbook step 2/3.
elaine: On it. Running scaling command now: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment/dedicated-pool-usw2 --replicas=24``` Will also flip fallback: ```redwood-cli deploy --model r-instruct-quant-8bit --route fallback``` Will report back within 3m.
ops-bot: Paging confirmation: primary oncall (john-oncall) acknowledged at 1735689612. Secondary (maya) on standby.
john-oncall: Quick notes from logs: KV cache OOM on node g4dn-8x. Evictions ~15s before spike. Pushing kernel flags to reduce memory for KV cache. Running command: ```ssh root@10.12.5.7 \"echo 1 > /proc/sys/inference/kv_cache_disable\"```
maya: Status page updated with initial message. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1735689600
serena.wong: I'll draft the internal incident slack post and customer email template.
serena.wong: Internal comms (short): ```Incident 1735689600 - Text gen 5xx spike in us-west-2. Owner: john-oncall. War room: https://warroom.redwood/rooms/WR-1735689600. Impact: intermittent 5xx for /v1/generate. Mitigation: scaling dedicated pool + fallback to quantized variant. Next update in 15 minutes.``` 
dave_kapoor: Customer-facing email template (short): ```Hi <Customer>, we're currently investigating intermittent failures impacting text generation in us-west-2. Our oncall team is engaged and we've initiated mitigation steps. We'll follow up with updates every 15 minutes or when we have a resolution. Apologies for the disruption.``` 
john-oncall: Mitigation step 1 completed: scaled pool to 24 replicas (kubectl OK). Mitigation step 2: fallback deployed but warming; observing success rate climb from 88% -> 96% on routed traffic.
elaine: Observability note: adding tag `incident:1735689600` to logs and traces. ```otelctl tag --key incident --value 1735689600``` 
serena.wong: Good. Everyone update the war room with what you do. If anything customer-impacting change, ping #support-critical. I'll own status page updates.
ryan-product: AMs notified. Sent targeted note to 3 enterprise customers in us-west-2. 
john-oncall: Next update in 10m. Temp owner handoff if I need a break: @maya please be ready.
maya: Ready. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Incident timeline marker logged: owner_assigned by john-oncall at 1735689628. 
serena.wong: Thanks team. If mitigation holds, prepare RCA timeline after stable. For now continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:
